1. (Currently amended) A composite stiffener, comprising: first, second and third members formed from laminated composite tape, the first and second members defining a web and __at least one flange__ member being joined to the flanges and extending generally transverse to the web, the first, second and third composite members intersecting to form a void; a filler disposed in and substantially filling the void; at least one layer of composite fabric on each of the members in the area of the filler, __wherein the composite fabric is applied as a separate layer distinct from the laminated composite tape forming the members__; and, a layer of adhesive surrounding the filler and joining the filler to the composite fabric.

2. (Previously presented)

3. (Previously presented)

4. (Original)

5. (Currently amended) The composite stiffener of claim 1, wherein the layer of adhesive and the at least one layer of composite fabric extend beyond the radius areas, __and wherein the layer of adhesive is applied as a separate layer distinct from any adhesive contained within the laminated composite tape__.

6. (Currently amended) The composite stiffener of claim 1, wherein the at least one layer of composite fabric of the composite members are offset relative to each other, __and wherein the offset is created by selective placement of the composite fabric layers rather than by wrinkles or deformation within the laminated composite tape__.

7. (Currently amended) A composite stiffener, comprising: a pair of composite channels joined together, each of the channels including a web, flanges extending from the web, and radius areas between the web and each of the flanges; a base extending transverse to the web and joined to each of the flanges, the radius areas of the channels and the base forming at least one radius filler zone; a reinforcing member filling the radius filler zone; a layer of composite fabric covering the radius areas of the channels and the base, __wherein the composite fabric is applied as a separate layer distinct from the laminated composite tape forming the channels and base__; and, a layer of adhesive surrounding the filler and joining the filler to the composite fabric layer, __wherein the adhesive layer is applied as a separate layer distinct from any adhesive contained within the laminated composite tape__.

8. (Original)

11. (Currently amended) The composite stiffener of claim 7, wherein the filler is one of: a formed unidirectional composite tape, a composite laminate, a hybrid tape-fabric member, __or__ a titanium member.

12. (Currently amended) The composite stiffener of claim 7, wherein the composite fabric layer includes three composite patches respectively on each of the channels and the base, __and wherein each patch is applied as a separate layer distinct from the laminated composite tape forming the channels and base__.

13. (Currently amended) The composite stiffener of claim 7, wherein the layer of adhesive includes a sheet of structural adhesive wrapped around the filler, __and wherein the structural adhesive is applied as a separate layer distinct from any adhesive contained within the laminated composite tape__.

14. (Original)

25. (Currently amended) A composite stiffener for aircraft applications, comprising: an I-section structure formed of laminated composite tape __with a web and__ flanges on each end of the web, the structure including a __pair of composite channels each__ including radius areas between the web and the flanges __and a cap and a base each__ joined to the first set of the flanges and the __second set of flanges, the cap and the base each intersecting the web in the radius areas to define a radius filler zone__; a layer of composite fabric covering the radius areas of the channels, cap and base, __wherein the composite fabric is applied as a separate layer distinct from the laminated composite tape forming the structure__; a reinforcing filler in the radius filler zone; and __a layer of adhesive surrounding and joining__ the filler to the composite fabric in the radius filler zone, __wherein the adhesive layer is applied as a separate layer distinct from any adhesive contained within the laminated composite tape__.
